tools.name: generate_qr_code
tools.description: Generate a QR code image. Use this whenever a user asks to create, make, or generate a QR code for a URL, website, WiFi network, contact card, email, or text. Returns a hosted image URL and a base64 data URL for inline display. Colour, size, dot and corner styling, frames and captions are free on ev

tools.name: list_qr_codes
tools.description: List QR codes saved to the authenticated user's account. Supports pagination and filtering by type. Requires an authenticated API key (Developer plan).

tools.name: get_analytics
tools.description: Get scan analytics for the authenticated user's QR codes. Optionally filter to a specific QR code by ID. Requires an authenticated API key (Developer plan).
